blocks.orig: The Kidoti Villas are two private luxury villas in the secluded village of Kidoti on the northern tip of Zanzibar Island. The villas are located on a small cliff in the middle of a tropical garden and are an idyllic retreat for families and groups alike. The spacious 2 and 4-bedroom villas are 200 and 300 square meters respectively, and boast a blend of Zanzibari Arabic style with contemporary English touches. Handcrafted wood furniture, marble floors, air-conditioning, en-suite bathrooms, and private terraces with hammocks and sun loungers, as well as tech gadgets like iPads, LED flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi await you. What’s more, a personal chef, waiter, butler, housekeeper, security guard, and villa manager will cater to your every need.
blocks.html: The Kidoti Villas are a pair of private luxury villas in the quiet village of Kidoti, at the northern tip of Zanzibar Island. Set on a small cliff within a tropical garden, they make an idyllic hideaway for families as well as groups. The roomy villas have 2 and 4 bedrooms and measure 200 and 300 square metres respectively, combining Zanzibari Arabic style with modern English touches. You’ll find handcrafted wooden furniture, marble floors, air-conditioning, en-suite bathrooms and private terraces with hammocks and sun loungers, along with tech such as iPads, LED flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. On top of this, a personal chef, waiter, butler, housekeeper, security guard and villa manager look after your every need.

blocks.orig: Spend relaxing hours in the infinity pool, watch the horses in the paddock, take them out for a ride, or take advantage of the facilities at the sister hotel The Z. Here you can pamper yourself in the hotel’s spa, dine in one of the two restaurants, or admire the incredible sunset with a cocktail on the rooftop bar.
